description: Pan Twardowski, the legendary Polish sorcerer, a tall nobleman in a long dark red kontusz robe with a black fur-trimmed cloak and a fur cap, a long black moustache and goatee, holding an open black magic book in one hand with fire rising from it, the other hand raised casting a spell, glowing eyes, menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the whole figure inside the picture
